config.hypothesis: Incremental cumulative exposure review and CPU-only pacing preserve legality and use 900 CPU seconds effectively on long multi-night tasks.
config.baseline: immutable v3.3 final-steady snapshot with the same 900 CPU allowance

datasets.name: L1, prior normal-b and 180-night/6000-target long-held
datasets.version: frozen official v4 and prior generated cards
datasets.identity: per-run full input SHA256 manifests; no runtime engine truth reads

random.rng: agent deterministic, inputs pre-generated and frozen
random.stream_policy: same fixed truth/weather/catalogue per paired run; CPU adaptation can alter paths

parallel.backend: independent host processes across cards; serial agent/scorer per run

environment.software: bundled Python3.12.14 stdlib, C++17, frozen official workflow and process CPU hook

controls.sample_ids: fixed public target IDs per card; own observe indices in audit
controls.selection: Initial expanded smoke regressed relative to prior normal-b; amend to paired smoke control + stable smoke, and two paired full-season cases. Preserve expanded prototype. D1 unavailable.; add one final long rerun because a derived-evidence resync patch changed the enhanced source after the first long run loaded it.; one exact-final normal-b smoke after fixing reserved manifest switch names (settings values unchanged); API freshness addition is model-enabled only.
controls.units_and_coordinates: UTC/degrees; normalized standard CPU and raw host CPU kept separate
controls.bin_edges_and_denominator: one official total per card and algorithm

paired_scores.definition: full official score/count/CPU report from both algorithms for L1 and long-held
paired_scores.uncertainty: one run each, CPU-adaptive variance not estimated

tests.definition: passed tests covering CPU semantics and incremental/replayed log analysis

reproducibility.tolerance: recorded action traces/score files exact; timed adaptive reruns can differ

config.success_criterion: complete legal episodes without mistaking engine/model waits for own CPU; test/build/protocol pass; report score tradeoffs

budget.stop_condition: nine recorded runs and successful exact-final package validation; stop further score tuning

git.limitation: 无 git commit；需外部源码快照，不能仅靠登记复现

own_audit.ratio_definition: unsaturated raw-factor bounds / public model factor, before learned throughput scaling
own_audit.limitations: raw/program ratios are intervals; cue alone cannot authorize a fault report or certify completion
